The '''Type 5 hunter-killer mine''' was a space-based stationary drone manufactured by [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]]. Each [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] was equipped with active and passive [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], and a [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]]. The mine was controlled by a [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] and was programmed to fire at targets not broadcasting a specific [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]].<ref name="FOP" />
